title: Stoichiometric Methane-Air Adiabatic Flame (HP)
description: Constant-enthalpy, constant-pressure (hp) equilibrium combustion of stoichiometric methane and dry air at 1 atm and 298.15 K to determine adiabatic flame temperature.
code:
# Stoichiometric Methane-Air Adiabatic Flame Temperature (HP Problem)
problem case=CH4_AIR_HP hp equilibrium
  p,atm=1.0 phi=1.0
reactants
  fuel=CH4 wt%=100 t(k)=298.15
  oxid=O2 wt%=23.2 t(k)=298.15
  oxid=N2 wt%=76.8 t(k)=298.15
output siunits short trace=1e-5
end

title: Hydrogen-Oxygen Combustion Equivalence-Ratio Sweep
description: Parametric equivalence-ratio sweep (phi = 0.5 to 2.0) of gaseous H2/O2 combustion at 10 bar evaluating dissociation of OH, H, and O radicals.
code:
# Gaseous Hydrogen-Oxygen Equivalence Ratio Sweep at 10 bar
problem case=H2_O2_SWEEP hp equilibrium
  p,bar=10.0 phi=0.5,0.8,1.0,1.2,1.5,2.0
reactants
  fuel=H2 wt%=100 t(k)=298.15
  oxid=O2 wt%=100 t(k)=298.15
only H2O H2 O2 OH H O HO2
output siunits short trace=1e-5
end

title: SSME-Class LOX/LH2 Rocket Nozzle Equilibrium
description: NASA RP-1311 RS-25 / SSME-class cryogenic LOX/LH2 rocket engine performance at 200 bar chamber pressure and 77.5:1 supersonic nozzle expansion ratio.
code:
# SSME-Class Cryogenic LOX/LH2 Rocket Engine Nozzle Equilibrium
problem case=SSME_LOX_LH2 rocket equilibrium
  p,bar=200.0 o/f=6.0 supar=77.5
reactants
  fuel=H2(L) wt%=100 t(k)=20.27
  oxid=O2(L) wt%=100 t(k)=90.17
output siunits short trace=1e-5
end

title: LOX/CH4 Methalox Chamber Pressure and Area Ratio Trade
description: Reusable booster LOX/liquid-methane rocket propulsion parametric trade across chamber pressures (100, 200, 300 bar), O/F ratios, and nozzle area ratios.
code:
# Reusable Booster LOX/CH4 (Methalox) Chamber Pressure and Area Ratio Trade
problem case=METHALOX_TRADE rocket equilibrium
  p,bar=100.0,200.0,300.0 o/f=3.2,3.5,3.8 subar=2.5 supar=16.0,35.0,80.0
reactants
  fuel=CH4(L) wt%=100 t(k)=111.66
  oxid=O2(L) wt%=100 t(k)=90.17
output siunits short trace=1e-5
end

title: Chapman-Jouguet Detonation of Stoichiometric H2-O2-N2
description: Chapman-Jouguet detonation wave velocity, pressure ratio, and post-detonation equilibrium state for stoichiometric hydrogen-oxygen diluted with nitrogen.
code:
# Chapman-Jouguet Detonation of Stoichiometric H2/O2/N2 Mixture
problem case=CJ_DET_H2O2 det
  p,bar=1.0,2.0,5.0 t,k=298.15
reactants
  fuel=H2 moles=2.0 t(k)=298.15
  oxid=O2 moles=1.0 t(k)=298.15
  oxid=N2 moles=1.0 t(k)=298.15
output siunits short trace=1e-5
end
